text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! Dang it, I lost! I didn't stand a
chance!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
That was some real competition... Guess
this
means my opponents were a lot
stronger than me!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: Let's get some more training in!

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know! Stopping now just doesn't
feel
right!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
We've gotta use today as fuel for our
next
victory!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
If my foes are this strong, I've gotta get
even
stronger! I'll come back swingin'
every time until
sweet victory is mine!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
It goes without saying! I'm not gonna let
'em push
me around forever!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
My legs know no limits! I'm gonna train
till I drop!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I don't plan on lettin' up—everyone on
that track
is in for a beatdown!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna treat the crowd to a race so
hot, their
blood will start pumpin' too!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I've got this! I'll use this setback as a
springboard
to get even faster!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'm ready to go, Teach! I'm gonna jump
squat the
whole way back!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
